text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing with Oguri Cap—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't that Oguri Cap over there?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It really is you! Oguri-san, I'm a huge fan!
I even went to see your last race!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Ah, yeah...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: How can I become as fast as that?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Umm...
Moving your legs... faster.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
...I-I see. It's simple, but
coming from you, Oguri-san, it's very convincing!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for bothering you with all this during your private time.
Well then, thank you very much~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Thank you as well.

The fan Uma Musume left the scene
looking absolutely delighted.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
choice_data_list: Not a fan of being surrounded by people?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Weaknesses... Hmm, I'd never really thought about it,
but now that you mention it, that might be true.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Back home, I wasn't really surrounded
by kids my own age, after all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...However, the more opportunities I had to run,
the more people started calling out to me."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case... I wonder if I should
learn how to handle these situations better.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Could you give me some advice?
choice_data_list: Alright, let's think this through together!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Could you give me some advice?
choice_data_list: Alright, let's think this through together!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...
With you beside me, Trainer, I feel like I can come up with some great ideas.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I may still have much to learn, but I'm counting on you.
choice_data_list: I-I don't think that's quite the right way to put it...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...?
I shouldn't have gotten the meaning of 'unworthy' wrong, though...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. You're saying it takes time to overcome one's weaknesses, right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If that is so...
then I shall look forward to working with you for a long time to come!

Setting aside Oguri Cap's unique choice of words,
we decided to practice later on to get her
accustomed to being surrounded by peers her age.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're right... I can't stay weak to it
forever. I'll show that I can endure even drastic measures.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...So, what are we doing?
choice_data_list: Let's go check out the flash sale!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"A flash sale...!
I see, that truly is the perfect setting to be surrounded by people."

Afterward, I went with Oguri Cap
to a flash sale at the shopping district, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: There's nothing left... Did I get off to a late start?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
The first few seconds of a flash sale are crucial, you know!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I see, so it's just like a race... I shall be more careful next time.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text: You runnin' in races, little lady?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
Then you two and that Trainer over there,
eat this and give it your all!

"I received two deli croquettes
that were on clearance sale."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? Thank you.
I promise I'll give this upcoming race everything I've got...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Desperate times really do call for desperate measures.
Even surrounded by all those people, I didn't get nervous at all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I got to eat croquettes too...
Trainer really is amazing.

While it feels like the element of being surrounded by girls her age was somewhat missing,
this experience surely proved valuable for her.
